source.title: Kotov, HardwareX 26 (2026) e00767: An open-source test stand for backlash measurement in low-cost UART servo motors

methodNote: Two STS3215 servos pull a 100 mm lever both ways; backlash is read on the device's own output encoder, unloaded and under load.

rig.torqueSensor: none (fixed pulling load from two servos)
rig.controller: Node.js controller over a USB-TTL adapter

note: Unloaded backlash about 0.62°; loaded about 1.30° (78 arcmin). Coupling two servos brought it to 0.47° to 0.67°.
